text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Monday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Lithuanian Gas and Russian Gazprom are expected to sign an agreement for gas supply in 1997 this week. If Lithuania consumes four billion cubic metres of gas, the price may be lower than this year.
- Legendary British pop group Electric Light Orchestra Part II arrived in Vilnius where it will hit fans with an avalanche of light and music in two concerts.
- The new government's programme will be approved in parliament and the ministers sworn in on Tuesday.
- European Union (EU) Commission experts were satisfied with the work carried out by Lithuania in making its laws consistent with EU legislation.

- Lithuania's Development bank will receive 2.5 million marks credit from Deutsche Investions und Entwicklungsgessellschaft and it intends to invest another 2.5 million marks into LDB's share capital.
